source_behavior.ownership: WordPressSyncWebService.SynchronizeAsync enforces site ownership before synchronization.
source_behavior.duplicate_click_guard: ContentExplorer ignores a second click while _syncing is true.
source_behavior.real_sync: The source invokes SyncService.SynchronizeAsync(Id), reports the result, then reloads Explorer data.
source_behavior.failure: Failures flow through the page error path and busy state is cleared in finally.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The control starts the existing real tenant/site sync, polls authoritative run state, surfaces terminal failure, and invalidates Explorer data only after successful completion.

security.tenant_isolation: route tenant must equal TenantContext tenant and site lookup is restricted to the active tenant

concurrency_and_idempotency.durable_replay: same idempotency key for the same tenant/site reuses the existing durable SyncRun without a second queue dispatch
concurrency_and_idempotency.conflicting_key_reuse: server rejects rebinding an idempotency key to another sync request
concurrency_and_idempotency.polling: queued/running are pending; succeeded/completed are success; failed/partial/cancelled states are terminal failure

coverage: real sync and authoritative status endpoints
no secret fields in status response

terminality.reason: Laravel preserves the ContentExplorer SynchronizeAsync boundary with a visible real synchronization control, durable idempotency, tenant/site authorization, authoritative polling, terminal failure handling, and post-success Explorer refresh.
